name: Central Services Building (UW central heating/cooling plant, with the UW smokestack)
sources_checked: around/sv_*_70 and _100 (all 17 wall poses + 12 corner poses): W7/W8/W6/W3 and c0/c1/c10/c11 Sep 2014 (sunny); W0/W1/W2/W9/W10/W11 and c2-c9 Jul 2019 (overcast); sv_W8_K_8T and c2 carry 2025 watermarks
around/earth_W*_whole, earth_W7/W8/W11_l|m|r, earth_corner_0-11 (2024, sunny; the louvre screens and fans mesh badly)
private/ortho_2023aug.jpg (walls drawn on it), ortho_2025summer.jpg, ortho_2026spring.jpg

gsc/facades.json for the GSC side of the gap behind W8
dating: Most current views: 2019 Street View of the north/east sides (W0-W2, W9-W11) and the 2024 Earth mesh; the lawn sides (W6-W8) are Sep 2014 Street View only. The 2023-2026 orthos show two changes since those photos: the big brown steel tank on the berm NW of W6 is gone (sand/construction in 2023, lawn in 2025), and a new single-storey annexe with two rooftop units stands against W6 by 2025 (see geometry_notes). A light grey equipment cabinet off the W7/W8 corner appears in the 2023+ orthos but not in 2014 Street View.

brick.where: all brick: boiler-house lawn walls W5-W7 and W9, cooling-tower block base W2/W3/W10, NE wing W0/W1/W11 and the W10 low block. Medium-dark brown, stretcher bond, dark-flecked. Samples are all shaded/overcast: W7 2014 shade #4f382b, W9 2019 overcast #564939, W11 #6d5e50, W10 #594734; ~1.6x exposure correction gives #8a6550-#8f7860. In the sunny 2014 frames it reads redder (brick_dark #9e6a58 would also be defensible for W6/W7); 2019 frames of W9 and W10 side by side show the same brick on the boiler house and the cooling block

beige_panels.where: smooth cream end-wall cladding of the boiler house: the SE gable W8 (from s 0.6 to the end, ground to 20.3 m) and (guess, Earth) the NW gable / W4. Sunlit SV 2014 #dad9d5-#dfdedd, overcast 2019 #9b826e, Earth #e5d0c2; faint vertical panel joints every ~3 m; reads warm cream, darker than white

louvre_screen.where: cooling-tower screen W2/W3/W10 and the hidden NE face, 9.4-16.0 m: closely spaced horizontal metal louvre slats (~0.25 m pitch). Overcast #555551-#696a6a, corrected ~#8a8a86

dark_band.where: 0.8 m dark grey metal band between the clerestory and the louvre screen on the cooling block, slightly proud (#5f5f5c-#737272 overcast)

silver_louvres.where: 3 m band of framed silver louvre panels at the top of the boiler house's tall end (W9 and the SW face above the roof): #7c7b78 overcast, Earth #a9b7c4

fascia.where: dark brown-grey metal fascias of the NE wing / carport (0.9 m) and low block, thin copings on the 7.2 m walls, steel man doors

clerestory.where: clerestory ribbon on the cooling block: white frames (panel_white) and dark glass, a few panes opaque white; W3 has only two windows, the rest dark panels (brick_charcoal_tower)

wall_louvres.where: rectangular aluminium wall louvres on W3/W6/W7 (light grey-beige, #494744 in shade)

overhead_doors.where: grey overhead door 24 and its steel man door (#3b3b3a overcast)

carport_backwall.where: painted concrete-block back wall of the carport (mauve-grey in shade); soffit is light ribbed metal (metal_panel)

stack.where: the 62 m round brick smokestack: buff-brown brick, sunlit 2014 #a48e7b, overcast 2019 #685d50-#6e6256 (Earth #b69389)

W0.summary: north end of the one-storey NE wing: a solid brown brick end wall (4.5 m) under the dark carport fascia; it closes the north end of the carport and faces the lawn and the service-drive bend
W0.notes: sv_W0_4mgl, sv_c6/c7/W2 (Jul 2019, 11-20 m away): plain brick, no openings, dark fascia continuing from W11; concrete curb at its foot on the drive side, lawn on the west.

W1.summary: short return of the NE wing back to the cooling block's NW face: 4.5 m brick with the dark fascia
W1.notes: Not seen square-on (behind the pines in sv_W1_g4ea / c6); assumed to continue W0. Lidar 4 m.

W2.summary: NW face of the cooling-tower block (16 m): brown brick base, a continuous clerestory ribbon of white-framed windows at 7.6-8.6 m, a dark grey band, then 6.6 m of horizontal grey louvre screen hiding the cooling fans; a wall louvre under the ribbon at the SW end
attached: steel pipe guardrail along the top of the screen (visible from the west)
W2.notes: sv_c6/c7/W2 (Jul 2019): from the north the right-hand face of the block. ~14 lites visible over most of the face at ~1.2-1.4 m pitch, white frames, some panes opaque white. The lower brick is hidden by the NE wing (W0/W1) and the pines; assumed plain. Row heights from W3 (sv_c11 crop, 46 px/m: windows z 8.0-8.8 above a berm) and lidar (deck ~9 m, screen top 15-16 m); +-0.4 m.

W3.summary: SW face of the cooling-tower block: brick base with a steel door and a low louvre at the north end, a big wall louvre right under the clerestory, only two clerestory windows (the rest dark panels), dark band, louvre screen; a brown board fence screens the south half at ground
attached: downpipe/control joint at s ~7.3
wall-pack lamp at s ~1.5, z 2.6 over the door
guardrail and a short silver vent stack on top of the screen near s 6
W3.notes: sv_c11_NwRB (Sep 2014) cropped at ~40 px/m: door s 0.6-2.0, big louvre s 2.2-4.5 at z 6.3-7.6, low louvre s 4.5-6.9, clerestory windows s 2.9-4.9 and 9.5-11.3, fence from s 7.5. Pano heading for this frame is ~10 deg off, so positions are scaled from the face width, +-0.7 m.

W4.summary: NW face of the boiler house's tall end, in the nook between the cooling block and the low NW wing: brick at the bottom (guess), cream panels up to 20.3 m
W4.notes: Only Earth (earth_W4_whole, earth_W6_whole, corner_10, 2024) shows it: a pale, plain face above the 7.2 m wing roof (pale in shade like the W8 cream, not the pink-brown Earth gives the brick). Ground level is a dark nook behind the fence (sv_c11). Lidar 19-21 m for s 4-9.

W5.summary: NE end of the low NW wing (7.2 m): plain brick behind the board-fenced equipment yard
W5.notes: Hidden behind the fence and the 2025 annexe in every view; assumed like W6.

W6.summary: NW side of the low wing: 7.2 m plain brown brick with a thin dark coping and one wall louvre near the west corner
attached: downpipe at the W7 corner
W6.notes: sv_c0/c10/c11/W6 (Sep 2014) see it at a grazing angle under a yellow-leaved tree: plain brick, louvre ~1.5 m from the W7 corner at the same height as W7's high louvre. Since 2024-25 a new annexe covers roughly s 11-21.6 of this wall (2025/2026 orthos; no photos), so the louvre may now be inside it.

W7.summary: long SW eave wall of the boiler house on the lawn: 7.2 m of plain brown brick with a thin dark coping, one high grey louvre near the west end, three low louvres at ~1 m sill and two wall-pack lamps
attached: wall-pack lamps (bronze box) at s ~6.7 and ~26.3, z ~4.8
faint vertical control joints at s ~12 and ~19
parapet steps up a few cm at s ~12 (west part slightly higher)
W7.notes: sv_W7_Obxs (square-on, 12.6 m), _lOqV and _3uPa (Sep 2014, wall in shade). Obxs puts the W7/W8 corner at s 26.8 instead of 30.1, so its positions were stretched (x1.15 about s 4.4) and averaged with lOqV/3uPa: high louvre centre 4.4 (z 2.7-4.0), low louvres 10.8, 17.9, 26.4, lamps 6.7 and 26.3; +-1 m. Scale 52 px/m at 12 m from the 7.2 m lidar height. The monopitch roof rises behind this eave (not visible from the lawn).

W8.summary: SE gable of the boiler house: smooth cream panels whose top follows the monopitch roof from 7.4 m up to ~18 m, then steps up to the 20.3 m flat-topped tall end; a brick corner strip at the west corner, a bronze steel door at 1.9 m reached by a black steel stair; the north 2/3 stands 1-4 m behind GSC's one-storey west wing
attached: black steel stair with landing and pipe railings: landing in front of the door (s 5.2-6.4, z 1.9), flight running down towards s ~8.5 along the wall, ~1.1 m wide
wall-pack lamp above the door at s ~5.7, z ~4.3
from s ~13 to the end the lower ~5 m is in the 1-4 m gap behind GSC's W7 (4.9 m roof): hidden, plain cream (GSC spec: 'W8's north end meets its white block wall (black steel stair)')
W8.notes: sv_W8_FPL3 and sv_c1 (Sep 2014, sunlit) and earth_W8_whole/corner_1/corner_3 (2024). Wall top profile (s, z): (0, 7.4) (2.9, 7.4) (22.0, 18.0) then vertical to 20.3 and flat to the end; read from Earth W8 (36 px/m) and checked against the lidar (8-10 m at s 0-6, 20 m at s 22-26). Brick corner strip s 0-0.6 up to the eave only. Door s 5.2-6.3 from FPL3 ray casting; door sill ~1.9 m from the stair's ~9 risers.

W9.summary: NE face of the boiler house's tall end, behind the smokestack: brown brick to 20.3 m, a ribbon of dark windows at ~7-7.8 m, a 3 m band of silver louvre panels at the top, the steel-scissor-gated door 22 on a raised landing at the north end, and the big dark breeching duct leaving the face at ~12-15 m for the stack
attached: breeching duct: dark grey metal box/duct ~3 m square leaving the face at s ~0-3, z ~11.5-15, spanning ~5 m NE to the stack (earth_corner_3, sv_W8_K_8T)
raised concrete landing with yellow bollards, blue bins and pallets in front of door 22, steps down along W10
W9.notes: sv_W9_hmDu _70/_100 and sv_c3 (Jul 2019); the stack hides s 0-6. Scale 18 px/m from the 20.3 m top: ribbon z 7.0-7.8, louvre band 17.2-20.3 in ~5 framed panels, door 22 z 0-2.6. Ribbon extent behind the stack is a guess (seen s 6-9.5). Door 22 sits at the inside corner with W10 (its scissor gate seen in sv_W10_xZfI_100). The lidar puts this face 2-3 m SW of the outline (ground 1 m inside at s 3-10).

W10.summary: SE side: s 0-19 the cooling-tower block (brick base with the open raised loading bay 23 behind an aluminium railing, clerestory ribbon, dark band, louvre screen to 16 m); s 19-28.5 the one-storey brick low block (4.5 m) with grey overhead door 24 + man door in a shallow recess and the open drive-in bay 25, dark fascia
attached: aluminium pipe railing across the sill of bay 23 (z ~1.2-2.2)
concrete steps with a steel handrail running down along the wall from the door 22/23 landing (s ~0-6) to the yard at s ~12 (ground falls ~1.2 m eastward)
door 24 and its man door sit ~1 m back under the low block's roof edge
W10.notes: sv_W10_xZfI _70/_100, sv_c3, sv_W9_hmDu, sv_W8_K_8T (2019; K8 2025 watermark). s 7-19 of the base is privacy-blurred in the 2019 frames: plain brick assumed. Door 23 position disagrees between frames (s 5-9 vs 11-12 after shifting the face 2.5 m out, see geometry_notes): s 6-9 taken. Low-block doors scaled to the 9.5 m block (raw ray positions came out 25% short). Rows: brick to 7.6, white sill, clerestory 7.6-8.6 (~14 lites, white frames), dark band 8.6-9.4, screen 9.4-16. The upper rows only exist over s 0-19.

W11.summary: street face of the one-storey NE wing (4.5 m): s 0-11.9 solid brown brick; s 11.9-31.9 an open carport 8.3 m deep (bike parking and staff cars) under a deep dark fascia on four black steel posts with yellow bollard sleeves; the cooling block's louvre screen rises behind it
attached: yellow bollard sleeves on every post, 0-1.3 m
bronze wall-pack lights on the fascia at s ~13 and ~29
carport soffit: light ribbed metal at 3.6 m (metal_panel) with ceiling lights; back wall painted concrete block with wall lights, galvanised bike racks along it for ~25 bikes
a wall-pack lamp on the solid part near s 11
W11.notes: sv_W11_pA4F, _X6Aw, _g4ea and sv_c9 (Jul 2019, 4-7 m away): solid/carport boundary s 11.9, posts at 14.3, 18.1-18.3, 22.9, 26.6-26.9 (ray casting, +-0.5 m), north end wall at 31.9. The carport is drawn as one deep recessed panel (back wall colour as 'glass'); its side reveals are the brick end walls. Depth = W0 length / the cooling block's NE face line (8.3 m).

geometry_notes: The lidar's 27-39 m blob over the SE half of the monopitch (art x 900-913, y 506-520) is the stack's steam plume, not structure: the boiler house tops out at 20.3 m.

Smokestack: round buff-brown brick, 62.6 m in the lidar, centre art (923.5, 521.5), ~5.5 m diameter at the base tapering to ~4.5 m at the cap; it stands free ~5 m NE of W9 and ~10 m SE of W10 s 5, tied to the boiler house by the breeching duct. Not in walls.json.

Boiler house roof is a monopitch: eave 7.2 m along W7, rising ENE to ~18 m at W8 s 22; the last ~8.5 m (W8 s 22-30.5, through to W4/W9) is a flat-topped tall end at 20.3 m. W8's top profile (s, z): (0, 7.4) (2.9, 7.4) (22.0, 18.0) (22.0, 20.3) (30.5, 20.3).
The tall end's SW face above the roof (z ~18-20.3, not in walls.json) carries the same 3 m silver louvre band as W9 (earth_W7_m, earth_W6_whole, earth_corner_1).

Low NW wing: flat 7.2 m roof, ~5.8 m deep along W6 (W5 is its NE end). The monopitch's NW gable wall rises from it on a line from W4 b (901.1, 535.0) parallel to W8 to W7 s ~6; pale cream like W8 in Earth (earth_W6_whole). Not in walls.json.

W9's real face is 2-3 m SW of the outline (lidar is ground 1 m inside for s 3-10, 20 m 4 m inside); W8 s 28-30.5 is ground 4 m inside, so the W8/W9 corner overshoots; the 16 m samples just inside W9 s 0-2 / W8 s 27-30 are the breeching duct.
W10 s 0-18: the cooling block's SE face is ~2-3 m SE of the outline (lidar 7-13 m 2 m outside, deck 8-10 m 1 m inside, fans 16-17 m 4 m inside); s 19-28.5 (low block, 4.5-5 m) is on the line.

Cooling-tower block: louvre screen walls to 16.0 m around an open-topped court; roof deck ~9 m; two 3-fan cooling units (~10 x 3.5 m each, fans ~2.5 m) at ~14-15 m. Its NE face (not in walls.json) runs on the line through W2 a parallel to W11, 8.3 m behind it, above the carport roof: same rows as W2 (clerestory lites in groups of 2-4 with dark posts, sv_c6 crop) over a painted-block lower wall that is the carport's back wall.
NE wing (W0, W1, W11 and W10 s 19-28.5) is one storey at 4.5 m; it projects 4.7 m NW of the cooling block's NW face (W1).

New since 2024 (2025 and 2026 orthos only, no photos): a single-storey annexe ~10 m along W6 (s ~11-21.6) x ~8 m out to the NW, light roof with two large grey rooftop units (generator/chiller enclosures?); height unknown (~4-5 m from its shadow). The 2023 ortho shows its foundations being formed. The brown steel tank (~7 m diameter, ~5-6 m tall, on a berm ~10 m NW of W6) seen in 2014 Street View and the lidar is gone by 2023.
